failure_summary.description: Filterable follow-ups triggered fresh searches or calls on unchanged domains instead of retrieving and filtering compatible cached results.
A category-limited cached attraction result was reused for a newly named attraction rather than searching for that entity.
Attraction categories or neighborhood text were normalized or shortened instead of preserving the requested values.

patch.reasoning: The recurring failures are already directly covered by the skill: it requires cache retrieval and filtering for covered scopes, leaves unchanged domains untouched, distinguishes named-entity scope, and preserves exact category and location values. Adding duplicate reminders would not address a remaining skill gap.
